h1: Buy Cannabis in Pattaya — Walk-In Shop on Soi Hollywood
intro: Labs Cannabis on Soi Hollywood is Pattaya's go-to spot for fresh indoor flower — especially White Widow, our flagship strain. We're five minutes from Walking Street, open daily, and priced by weight from 1g (300฿) up to 1kg wholesale (40,000฿). No appointment needed: walk in, try a free in-store sample, and pay cash or QR. Prefer to message first? WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 — we usually reply within five minutes.

sections.h2: Why guests choose Labs Cannabis (formerly Labs Dispensary)
sections.body: Google rates us 4.8 stars with 91 reviews for a reason: transparent weight pricing, no pushy upsells, and staff who actually know the product. Dima speaks Russian and English and helps first-timers pick the right amount. Whether you want a single gram to try or 10g as our most popular tier, the price on the site is the price in the shop.

Find us at 32 Pattaya 13 Alley (Soi Hollywood), Chon Buri 20150. From Walking Street, walk five minutes into the alley and look for LABS DISPENSARY signage on your left. Same shop many locals still search as Labs Dispensary — now Labs Cannabis, same address, same quality.

faq.q: Do I need a medical card?
faq.a: Yes — Thailand requires a medical cannabis card for adults 20+. We help you complete the digital form on-site in about two minutes, free of charge.

faq.q: Can I try before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. We offer a free in-store sample so you can check freshness and quality before committing to a weight tier.
100g and 1kg tiers are listed on our price ladder. Message us on WhatsApp first to confirm availability for large orders.

closing: Ready to order? Tap any weight tier to open WhatsApp with a pre-filled message, or walk in today on Soi Hollywood. Labs Cannabis — premium buds, honest prices, Pattaya.
